name: Blameless Post-Mortem Arc
axiom: Report the system that failed, never the person who was holding it.
trigger: Production incident reviews and operational reporting, where the next incident must be cheaper than this one.

steps.text: Baseline: what normal operation looked like before.
Anomaly: the first signal, and when it was visible.
Cascade: how one failure reached the next.
Remediation: what stopped it, and how long it took.
Hardening: the change that makes this cascade impossible.

antiPattern.violation: A timeline that names the engineer who ran the command, which teaches everyone to write careful timelines instead of honest ones.
antiPattern.remediation: Name the condition that made the command look correct. The fix is in the system, not the person.

origin.title: Blameless PostMortems and a Just Culture

prompt: The condition that made the wrong action look right was ______.
